description: Use this when you need to insert a new feature line into a script. Insert a new feature line into a kernelCAD script before the last top-level return statement. Returns the modified code as text plus diagnostics from re-evaluating the result. Side-effect-free. Primitives that accept faceLabels (box, cylinder, extrudeRect, extrudeCircle, extrudePolygon, extrudeRoundedRect) can receive `opts.faceLabels` in the inserted code — use `lookup_api` to see `featureKindFaceLabels` for the full value schema.

feature_code.description: Single-statement source line to insert (e.g. `const hole = cylinder(5, 2).translate(10, 10, -1);`).

name: add_feature

binding_name.description: JS const name bound to the new construct (when one was created).

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics from re-evaluating the modified source.

error.description: Failure message (present when ok is false).

new_code.description: Modified .kcad.ts source (present on success). Caller persists it.

ok.description: Whether the edit applied and re-evaluated cleanly.

title: Add Feature
